_comment: What an @UVRANGE growth rule can work out and write: the one list both runtimes use.
php/GrowthOutputs.php reads this file; tests/gen_mode_registry.cjs writes the engine's copy into js/engine.js
(the @generated growth-outputs block) and CI fails when that copy is stale.
A key is an output id, or an id, a colon and a parameter when the entry has "param": valueAtZ:-2, valueAtPercentile:97.
written: number or text. places: the decimals a number, or the numbers in a text, are written with: z (always 2), decimals (the rule's
"decimals"), percentileDecimals (the rule's "percentileDecimals"). integer: a number written with 0 decimals may go
into an integer field. needs: what the value is made from besides the sex and the age or length: measurement
(the typed value), limit-low, limit-high, limit-any (the rule's limits on that side), or none.
param: the parameter's meaning, its range (both ends included) and the most decimals it may have.
shapes: where the output may appear; value is one field of "return".
example: a field name the parser suggests; {param} stands for the parameter, - written m and . written _.
label: the English name of the output. Every id must be one GrowthReference::COMPUTED and QRID_GROWTH_COMPUTED list.
